definitions.gloss: sharing, joint ownership, having in common
definitions.explanation: Possessing or using something together with others. Covers both physical joint ownership (property, resources) and abstract sharing (information, values, experiences).

examples.japanese: ファイルを{共有|きょうゆう}する。
この{問題|もんだい}{意識|いしき}はチーム{全体|ぜんたい}で{共有|きょうゆう}している。
examples.english: This awareness of the problem is shared across the entire team.

examples.japanese: {兄弟|きょうだい}で{一|ひと}つの{部屋|へや}を{共有|きょうゆう}して{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: I grew up sharing one room with my siblings.

notes:
Very common in both everyday and business/technical contexts. Frequently used with digital content (files, data, links) as well as physical spaces and abstract concepts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{情報|じょうほう}を{共有|きょうゆう}する (share information)
・{価値観|かちかん}を{共有|きょうゆう}する (share values)
・{共有|きょうゆう}スペース (shared space)
・{共有|きょうゆう}{財産|ざいさん} (joint property)
・{共有|きょうゆう}{名義|めいぎ} (joint ownership title)

DISTINCTIONS:
・{共有|きょうゆう}: sharing ownership or use of something with others
・{共用|きょうよう}: shared use (emphasizes using the same facility/equipment, not ownership)
